parsed_json.uq_surface: Show the exact IC50 activity values (in nM) for compounds tested in the HDAC6 assay (CHEMBL1865) that have a canonical SMILES and are from a PubMed‑indexed document, listing each compound's ChEMBL ID, SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, and target name and organism.
